I AM GOING TO THE BANK.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
I AM GOING TO THE BANK.exampleZh: 對方詢問「Where are you going? (你要去哪裡？)」，回答目的地「I am going to the bank. (我要去銀行)」最正確

I AM READING AN EMAIL.meaning: 我正在讀一封電子郵件
I AM READING AN EMAIL.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
I AM READING AN EMAIL.exampleZh: 對方詢問「What are you doing? (你正在做什麼？)」，回答正在進行的動作「I am reading an email. (我正在讀一封電子郵件)」最正確

SHE IS MY MANAGER.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
SHE IS MY MANAGER.exampleZh: 對方詢問「Who is she? (她是誰？)」，回答她的身分「She is my manager. (她是我的經理)」最正確

YES IT IS MINE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES IT IS MINE.exampleZh: 對方詢問「Is this your pen? (這是你的筆嗎？)」，回答「Yes, it is mine. (是的，它是我的)」最正確

SORRY I AM USING IT.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
SORRY I AM USING IT.exampleZh: 對方詢問「Can I use your computer? (我能用你的電腦嗎？)」，禮貌拒絕「Sorry, I am using it. (抱歉，我正在用它)」很合適

YES I DRINK IT EVERY DAY.word: yes, i drink it every day.
YES I DRINK IT EVERY DAY.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES I DRINK IT EVERY DAY.exampleZh: 對方詢問喜好「Do you like coffee? (你喜歡咖啡嗎？)」，回答「Yes, I drink it every day. (是的，我每天都喝)」最自然

IT IS VERY HOT.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
IT IS VERY HOT.exampleZh: 對方詢問天氣「How is the weather? (天氣如何？)」，回答天氣狀況「It is very hot. (非常熱)」最正確

IN TEN MINUTES.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
IN TEN MINUTES.exampleZh: 對方詢問抵達時間「When will he arrive? (他何時會抵達？)」，回答時間點「In ten minutes. (十分鐘後)」最正確

NO THEY ARE FROM TAIWAN.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
NO THEY ARE FROM TAIWAN.exampleZh: 對方詢問國籍「Are they from Japan? (他們來自日本嗎？)」，回答「No, they are from Taiwan. (不，他們來自台灣)」最符合邏輯

AT ELEVEN OCLOCK.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
AT ELEVEN OCLOCK.exampleZh: 對方詢問就寢時間「What time do you go to bed? (你幾點上床睡覺？)」，回答時間「At eleven o'clock. (十一點鐘)」最正確

THEY ARE FIFTY DOLLARS.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
THEY ARE FIFTY DOLLARS.exampleZh: 詢問鞋子的價格「How much are these shoes? (這雙鞋多少錢？)」，回答價格「They are fifty dollars. (它們五十元)」最正確

YES LET ME CHECK.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES LET ME CHECK.exampleZh: 在商店詢問尺寸「Do you have a small size? (你們有小號的嗎？)」，店員回答「Yes, let me check. (有的，讓我查一下)」最合理

I WILL HAVE THE CHICKEN.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
I WILL HAVE THE CHICKEN.exampleZh: 詢問想吃什麼「What would you like to eat? (你想要吃點什麼？)」，回答食物「I will have the chicken. (我要吃雞肉)」最正確

TAKE BUS NUMBER FIVE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
TAKE BUS NUMBER FIVE.exampleZh: 詢問交通方式「How can I get to the supermarket? (我要怎麼去超市？)」，指示搭乘公車「Take bus number five. (搭五號公車)」最正確

YES WEAR A COAT.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES WEAR A COAT.exampleZh: 詢問外面天氣「Is it cold outside? (外面很冷嗎？)」，回答並給予建議「Yes, wear a coat. (是的，穿件外套吧)」最貼切

IT STARTS AT SEVEN.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
IT STARTS AT SEVEN.exampleZh: 詢問電影放映時間「What time is the movie? (電影幾點播？)」，回答時間點「It starts at seven. (它七點開始)」最正確

THREE PLEASE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
THREE PLEASE.exampleZh: 詢問數量「How many apples do you want? (你想要幾顆蘋果？)」，回答數字「Three, please. (請給我三顆)」最正確

NO JUST A FIVE-MINUTE WALK.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
NO JUST A FIVE-MINUTE WALK.exampleZh: 詢問距離「Is the station far from here? (車站離這裡很遠嗎？)」，回答時間距離「No, just a five-minute walk. (不遠，只要走五分鐘)」很自然合適

NO THE SUN IS SHINING.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
NO THE SUN IS SHINING.exampleZh: 詢問今日是否下雨「Will it rain today? (今天會下雨嗎？)」，回答天氣現況「No, the sun is shining. (不會，太陽正在發光呢)」最正確

IT IS FRIDAY.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
IT IS FRIDAY.exampleZh: 原句：What day is today?（今天是星期幾？）最適合的回應是 It is Friday. (今天是星期五

IT IS ONE HUNDRED DOLLARS.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
IT IS ONE HUNDRED DOLLARS.exampleZh: 原句：How much is this book?（這本書多少錢？）最適合的回應是 It is one hundred dollars. (這是一百元

YES I DO.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES I DO.exampleZh: 原句：Do you like cats?（你喜歡貓嗎？）最適合的回應是 Yes, I do. (是的，我喜歡

MY FAVORITE COLOR IS BLUE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
MY FAVORITE COLOR IS BLUE.exampleZh: 原句：What is your favorite color?（你最喜歡的顏色是什麼？）最適合的回應是 My favorite color is blue. (我最喜歡藍色

I GET UP AT SEVEN OCLOCK.word: i get up at seven o'clock.
I GET UP AT SEVEN OCLOCK.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
I GET UP AT SEVEN OCLOCK.exampleZh: 原句：What time do you get up?（你幾點起床？）最適合的回應是 I get up at seven o'clock. (我七點起床

COFFEE.example: I drink coffee in the morning.

BANANA.example: He eats a banana after lunch.

IS.exampleZh: 介紹一個人用 This is...。

TICKET.example: Excuse me, where can I buy a train ticket to Taichung?

HAS.exampleZh: 第三人稱單數（he / she / it）的 have 要變成 has。

BECAUSE.example: A: What is your favorite season? B: I like spring because the weather is warm and nice.
BECAUSE.exampleZh: 後句是喜歡春天的原因，表原因的連接詞用 because。

AT.example: I get up at seven o'clock.

THERE ARE.example: Look at the map! there are two famous night markets near our hotel.
THERE ARE.exampleZh: 表示「有」且後方主詞 two famous night markets 為複數名詞，應用 There are。

MY.exampleZh: 名詞前用所有格 my（我的）。

DRINKS.exampleZh: 現在簡單式，第三人稱單數（he）動詞加 -s：drink → drinks。

CANNOT.example: The museum is closed today, so visitors cannot enter the building.
CANNOT.exampleZh: 因博物館今天休館，故參觀者「無法/不能」進入，填 cannot。

HOW.example: A: Excuse me, how can I get to the nearest convenience store? B: Just walk straight for two minutes. It is next to the bank.
HOW.exampleZh: 詢問前往某處的方法或路線，使用疑問詞 how。

DOES.example: A: What time does the new manager arrive at the company? B: She usually arrives at 8:45 every morning.
DOES.exampleZh: 主詞 the new manager 為第三人稱單數，一般動詞 arrive 的現在簡單式疑問句應使用助動詞 does。

HIS.example: Tom is a doctor. He works in a big hospital, and his wife works in a school as an English teacher.
HIS.exampleZh: 先行詞 Tom 為男性，對應的男性單數所有格形容詞為 his。

IN A CAF.example:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Kevin! I am at the café across from the train station. The coffee here is great and they have free Wi-Fi. What time will you arrive?
Q: Where is the writer right now?
IN A CAF.exampleZh: 文中第二句「I am at the café across from the train station.」直接指出作者目前在咖啡廳

A CLIENT IS VISITING.meaning: 因此大家需要穿著正式服裝接見客戶
A CLIENT IS VISITING.example:
【短文理解】[Email to Team] Dear all, our client from Japan will visit our office at 10:00 a.m. tomorrow. Please wear formal clothes and prepare the new product pictures.
Q: Why should the workers dress formally tomorrow?
A CLIENT IS VISITING.exampleZh: 信中提到「our client from Japan will visit our office at 10:00 a.m. tomorrow」，因此大家需要穿著正式服裝接見客戶

AT A HOSPITAL.example:
【短文理解】[Travel Card Note] You can use this travel card for the MRT, city buses, and local trains. You can add money to your card at any convenience store or MRT station.
Q: Where CANNOT you add money to this card according to the note?
AT A HOSPITAL.exampleZh: 文中僅列出便利商店與捷運站可以加值，沒有提到醫院 (hospital)，因此醫院是無法加值的地方

THE WRITER IS SICK.example:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Amy, I cannot go to the gym with you tonight. I have a bad headache, so I want to go to bed early. Let's exercise together next week.
Q: Why does the writer cancel the gym plan?
THE WRITER IS SICK.exampleZh: 作者提到「I have a bad headache」（頭很痛），說明生病不舒服是取消運動的原因

GO TO THE GARDEN.example:
【短文理解】[Sign at the Library] Quiet, please! Do not talk loudly on your mobile phone in the reading area. If you need to make a call, please walk outside to the garden.
Q: What should people do if they need to speak on the phone?
GO TO THE GARDEN.exampleZh: 告示最後一句指出「If you need to make a call, please walk outside to the garden.」，因此應前往花園

SPEAKS.example: My supervisor speaks two languages: English and Japanese.
SPEAKS.exampleZh: 主詞 My supervisor 是單數第三人稱，現在簡單式動詞字尾加 -s 寫作 speaks。

HER.example: This isn't Susan's bag. her bag is black, but this one is brown.
HER.exampleZh: 修飾名詞 bag 需要使用所有格形容詞 Her。

THERE IS.example: there is a new supermarket near my apartment, so shopping is very convenient.
THERE IS.exampleZh: 表示某地存在某物，且後方主詞 a new supermarket 為單數，使用 There is。

DONT DRINK.example: My parents don't drink coffee in the evening because it keeps them awake all night.
DONT DRINK.exampleZh: 主詞 My parents 為複數名詞，現在簡單式動詞否定句應使用 don't + 原形動詞 drink

IS THERE.example: A: Excuse me, is there a post office around here? B: Yes, walk straight and it is on your left.
IS THERE.exampleZh: 詢問單數名詞 a post office 是否存在，疑問句需倒裝為 Is there...?(A) are there 用於複數名詞。

ON THE FOURTH FLOOR.meaning: 請使用四樓休息室的機器
ON THE FOURTH FLOOR.example:
【短文理解】[Office Notice] The second-floor coffee machine is broken today. The repair person will fix it tomorrow morning. In the meantime, please use the machine in the break room on the fourth floor.
Q: Where can employees get coffee today?
ON THE FOURTH FLOOR.exampleZh: 告示說明二樓咖啡機故障，臨時方案是「please use the machine in the break room on the fourth floor」（請使用四樓休息室的機器）

EVERY 30 MINUTES.example:
【短文理解】[Bus Timetable Note] Bus Route 5: Bus arrives every 15 minutes on weekdays. On weekends and national holidays, the bus runs once every 30 minutes from 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.
Q: How often does Route 5 run on Sunday afternoon?
EVERY 30 MINUTES.exampleZh: 週日屬於週末（weekends），文中明確指出「On weekends... the bus runs once every 30 minutes」，因此為每 30 分鐘一班

TO OSAKA.meaning: 明天我們要搭新幹線去大阪
TO OSAKA.example:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Kyoto] Dear Helen, Greetings from Japan! The weather here is cool and sunny. We visited two old temples yesterday and took hundreds of photos. Tomorrow we are taking a bullet train to Osaka. Best, Mark.
Q: Where will Mark go tomorrow?
TO OSAKA.exampleZh: 明信片中寫道「Tomorrow we are taking a bullet train to Osaka.」（明天我們要搭新幹線去大阪），故選 A

TELL THE FRONT DESK TONIGHT.example:
【短文理解】[Hotel Reception Sign] Breakfast is served from 6:30 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. in the dining room on the 1st floor. If you need early check-out before 6:00 a.m., please inform the front desk tonight.
Q: What should guests do if they want to check out at 5:30 tomorrow morning?
TELL THE FRONT DESK TONIGHT.exampleZh: 文中說明如果需要在早上六點前退房（early check-out before 6:00 a.m.），請「inform the front desk tonight」（今晚告知櫃檯），故選 B

THE STAIRS.example:
【短文理解】[Company Memo] To all staff: The building elevator will be inspected this Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. During this time, the elevator will stop working. Please use the stairs if you come to the office.
Q: What should people use to go upstairs on Saturday morning?
THE STAIRS.exampleZh: 文中提到電梯停用期間「Please use the stairs if you come to the office.」（請走樓梯），故選 C

HER SALES NUMBERS.example:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Tina, our boss said we have to hand in the sales report by 11:30 a.m. today. I am almost done with my part. Can you send me your sales numbers in ten minutes?
Q: What does the writer need from Tina?
HER SALES NUMBERS.exampleZh: 文中問句明確寫出「Can you send me your sales numbers in ten minutes?」，需要的是業務數字，故選 D

IT ENDS AT 1200 NOON.meaning: 優惠有效至中午十二點止
IT ENDS AT 1200 NOON.example:
【短文理解】[Café Board] Today's Special: Buy any large hot drink and get a chocolate donut for only $10. Offer valid until 12:00 noon. Cash and Line Pay only.
Q: Which is true about the special offer?
IT ENDS AT 1200 NOON.exampleZh: 文中提到「Offer valid until 12:00 noon.」（優惠有效至中午十二點止），因此 A 正確

IN THE BLUE BIN.example:
【短文理解】[Notice at Fitness Center] Clean towels are available at the front counter. Please put used towels into the blue bin next to the shower room after you finish exercising. Thank you for keeping our gym clean.
Q: Where should members put their towels after exercising?
IN THE BLUE BIN.exampleZh: 文中指出「put used towels into the blue bin next to the shower room」，毛巾用完應放入藍色收集桶

SHE EATS AT THE NIGHT MARKET.word: she eats at the night market.
SHE EATS AT THE NIGHT MARKET.example:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Kenting] Hi Jack, Kenting is amazing! We are staying at a small hotel near the beach. Every morning we go swimming, and in the evening we eat seafood at the night market. See you next Monday! Emily.
Q: What does Emily do in Kenting in the evening?
SHE EATS AT THE NIGHT MARKET.exampleZh: 文中提到「in the evening we eat seafood at the night market」，傍晚在夜市吃海鮮，故選 D

A GUEST BADGE.example:
【短文理解】[Office Sign] Welcome to the New Media Department. All visitors must register at the reception desk on the 1st floor and get a guest badge before going up to the 5th floor.
Q: What must a visitor get on the 1st floor before going upstairs?
A GUEST BADGE.exampleZh: 告示最後指明訪客必須「get a guest badge before going up」（取得訪客證證件），故選 D

PUT THE GREEN CARD ON THE BED.word: put the green card on the bed.
PUT THE GREEN CARD ON THE BED.meaning: 想換床單需將綠色卡片放在床上
PUT THE GREEN CARD ON THE BED.example:
【短文理解】[Notice in Hotel Room] Dear Guest: Our hotel cares about nature. If you want us to change your bedsheets and towels, please put this green card on your bed before 10:00 a.m. Otherwise, we will not change them today.
Q: What should a guest do if they want fresh bedsheets?
PUT THE GREEN CARD ON THE BED.exampleZh: 說明提到「please put this green card on your bed before 10:00 a.m.」，想換床單需將綠色卡片放在床上，故選 B

RAIN.example: Take an umbrella in the rain.

KITCHEN.example: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.

CAMERA.example: I took photos with my camera.

MENU.example: Could we have the menu, please?

I RIDE A BIKE EVERY DAY.word: i ride a bike every day
I RIDE A BIKE EVERY DAY.example: I ride a bike every day.

DO YOU HAVE A LARGE SIZE.word: do you have a large size
DO YOU HAVE A LARGE SIZE.example: Do you have a large size.

HOSPITAL.example: She works at the city hospital.

VISITS.example: My uncle lives in Tainan, and he visits our family twice a month.
VISITS.exampleZh: 主詞 he 為第三人稱單數，現在簡單式動詞字尾須加 -s 寫作 visits。

RECEIPT.example: Excuse me, can I have the paper receipt to check the price of each item?
RECEIPT.exampleZh: 購物結帳後核對商品金額的明細紙條是「收據/發票」receipt。

CAN.example: Lisa is very musical. She can play the piano and guitar.
CAN.exampleZh: 助動詞 can 表能力，後接動詞原形且字尾不可變化。

WHO.example: A: who is sitting next to Tom today? B: It is our new classmate, Jason.
WHO.exampleZh: 根據回答「新同學 Jason」，可知在詢問坐在旁邊的「人是誰」，疑問詞選 Who。

DONT.example: My brothers are very athletic, but they don't like watching football on TV.
DONT.exampleZh: 主詞 they 是複數代名詞，現在簡單式一般動詞 like 的否定句須搭配助動詞 don't

ARE THERE.example: A: Excuse me, are there any computer labs in this building? B: Yes, there are two on the third floor.
ARE THERE.exampleZh: 修飾複數名詞 computer labs 的存在性疑問句，應將 be 動詞倒裝為 Are there...?(A) is there 用於單數名詞。

HOBBY.exampleZh: 我最喜歡的嗜好是閱讀。

examples.zh: 我最喜歡的嗜好是閱讀。

examples.en: He has a new hobby now.

IN ROOM 204.example:
【短文理解】[School Notice] English Speaking Club meets every Tuesday at 4:30 p.m. in Room 204. Please bring your student ID and a notebook. Everyone is welcome to join!
Q: Where does the English Speaking Club meet?
IN ROOM 204.exampleZh: 公告清楚註記「in Room 204」，故聚會地點選 A

IN THE AFTERNOON.example:
【短文理解】[Weather Board] Taipei Weather Today: Morning: Sunny, 26°C. Afternoon: Sudden heavy rain and thunderstorms, 22°C. Evening: Windy and cool, 19°C.
Q: When are thunderstorms expected today?
IN THE AFTERNOON.exampleZh: 資訊板顯示「Afternoon: Sudden heavy rain and thunderstorms」，午後有雷雨，故選 D

COFFEE CUPS.meaning: 學習製作自己的咖啡杯
COFFEE CUPS.example:
【短文理解】[Community Center Poster] Weekend Pottery Class: Learn to make your own coffee cups! Every Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00. All clay and tools are included in the fee.
Q: What do students make in this Saturday class?
COFFEE CUPS.exampleZh: 海報載明「Learn to make your own coffee cups!」（學習製作自己的咖啡杯），故選 A

SHE PICKED STRAWBERRIES.example:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Hsinchu] Dear Tina, we visited a strawberry farm in Guanxi this morning! We picked a big basket of fresh fruit and tasted sweet jam. Tomorrow we are visiting the old street. Love, Emily.
Q: What did Emily do on the farm this morning?
SHE PICKED STRAWBERRIES.exampleZh: 明信片開頭說明拜訪草莓農場，並提到「picked a big basket of fresh fruit」（採了一大籃新鮮水果），故選 B

THREE LOAVES.example:
【短文理解】[Bakery Sign] Today's Bake: Warm garlic bread comes out of the oven at 11:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. Limit of three loaves per customer. Cash and EasyCard accepted.
Q: How many loaves of garlic bread can one customer buy at most?
THREE LOAVES.exampleZh: 告示指明「Limit of three loaves per customer」（每位顧客限購三條），故選 C

WASH THEM IMMEDIATELY.example:
【短文理解】[Office Kitchen Notice] Please wash all spoons, mugs, and plates immediately after eating. Do not leave dirty items in the sink overnight. The cleaning team clears the sink every day at 6:00 p.m.
Q: What should employees do with their dirty mugs after using them?
WASH THEM IMMEDIATELY.exampleZh: 告示第 1 句指示「Please wash all spoons, mugs, and plates immediately after eating」，必須立刻清洗，故選 D

A TUNA SANDWICH.example:
【短文理解】[Text Message Chain] Mike: 'Hi Sarah, are you coming to lunch with us?' Sarah: 'I have to finish checking this invoice for the boss. Can you bring a tuna sandwich back for me?' Mike: 'Sure, no problem.'
Q: What does Sarah want Mike to bring for her?
A TUNA SANDWICH.exampleZh: Sarah 詢問「Can you bring a tuna sandwich back for me?」，需要的是鮪魚三明治，故選 A

A SWIMMING CAP.example:
【短文理解】[School Swimming Pool Rules] Swimming Pool Hours: Monday-Friday 06:00-21:00. Saturday 08:00-18:00. All swimmers must wear a swimming cap and shower before entering the pool.
Q: What must everyone wear in the pool?
A SWIMMING CAP.exampleZh: 泳池規定「All swimmers must wear a swimming cap」（所有泳客必須戴泳帽），故選 B

PUMPKIN SOUP AND GARLIC BREAD.meaning: 贈送南瓜濃湯與大蒜麵包
PUMPKIN SOUP AND GARLIC BREAD.example:

HAVE.exampleZh: 主詞 we 搭配 have。

ARE.exampleZh: 主詞 they 搭配 are。

FOLDER.example: Save the file in this folder.
FOLDER.exampleZh: 把檔案存在這個資料夾。

WHOSE.example: A: whose bag is this on the classroom chair? B: It belongs to our teacher, Mr. Chen.
WHOSE.exampleZh: 詢問物品「是誰的」所有權，疑問詞使用 Whose。

ASK.example: A: Do you know the answer to Question 5? B: No, I don't. Let's ask the teacher for help.
ASK.exampleZh: 祈使句提議句型「Let's」後面必須接動詞原形，故選 ask。

TAKES.example: Mr. Lin does not work on weekends. He always takes his family to the park on Saturdays.
TAKES.exampleZh: 主詞 He 是單數第三人稱，頻率副詞 always 後的現在簡單式動詞字尾加 -s 寫作 takes。

AROUND.example: A: May I try on this coat? B: Yes, of course. The fitting room is around the corner over there.
AROUND.exampleZh: 表示位置在「轉角處/轉角過去」，英語常用 around the corner。

BEFORE 330 PM.example:

BEFORE 330 PM.exampleZh: 告示明確指出「Please return all borrowed books to the front desk before 3:30 p.m.」，因此還書截止時間是 3:30 p.m. 前

THE COMPANY MEETING FINISHES LATE.meaning: 公司會議今晚會很晚結束
THE COMPANY MEETING FINISHES LATE.example:

Q: Why will the sender miss the family dinner?
THE COMPANY MEETING FINISHES LATE.exampleZh: 簡訊開頭解釋「the company meeting will finish late tonight」（公司會議今晚會很晚結束），故選 C

BRUSHES AND PAPER.meaning: 畫筆與畫紙全部免費提供
BRUSHES AND PAPER.example:
【短文理解】[Holiday Activity Poster] Weekend Art Workshop: Learn to paint flowers this Saturday from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. Fee: $300 per person. All brushes and paper are provided for free.
Q: What is provided for free at the workshop?
BRUSHES AND PAPER.exampleZh: 海報末句載明「All brushes and paper are provided for free.」（畫筆與畫紙全部免費提供），故選 A

TO THE HOT SPRINGS.example:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Yilan] Dear Grandma, we are having a wonderful holiday in Yilan! Yesterday we visited a tea farm, and today we went to the hot springs. The air here is very fresh. Love, Penny.
Q: Where did Penny go today?
TO THE HOT SPRINGS.exampleZh: 明信片提到「today we went to the hot springs」（今天去了溫泉），故選 B

LOCK THE FRONT DOOR.meaning: 最後離開者必須鎖大門
LOCK THE FRONT DOOR.example:
【短文理解】[Office Notice] Please remember to lock the front door if you are the last person to leave the office in the evening. Also, make sure all lights are switched off.
Q: What should the last worker do before leaving?
LOCK THE FRONT DOOR.exampleZh: 告示指出「remember to lock the front door if you are the last person to leave」，最後離開者必須鎖大門，故選 C

A CARTON OF FRESH MILK.example:
【短文理解】[Bakery Discount Note] Buy two loaves of toast after 7:00 p.m. and get a carton of fresh milk for half price! This special discount is available every evening while supplies last.
Q: What item is half price after 7:00 p.m. when buying two loaves of toast?
A CARTON OF FRESH MILK.exampleZh: 告示說明「get a carton of fresh milk for half price」（鮮奶半價），故選 D

FOUR PLAYERS.meaning: 現在有四個人，還差一位
FOUR PLAYERS.example:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi David, do you want to play badminton at the sports center this Saturday morning? We have four people now and we need one more player. Let me know today!
Q: How many players do they have right now?
FOUR PLAYERS.exampleZh: 簡訊提到「We have four people now and we need one more player.」（現在有四個人，還差一位），因此目前有 4 人，選 A

PUT THEM INTO THEIR BAGS.meaning: 上課時需將手機放進包包
PUT THEM INTO THEIR BAGS.example:
【短文理解】[School Classroom Rules] 1. Arrive in class before 8:10 a.m. 2. Put mobile phones into your bags during lessons. 3. Raise your hand before you ask a question.
Q: What should students do with their mobile phones during lessons?
PUT THEM INTO THEIR BAGS.exampleZh: 規則第 2 條指明「Put mobile phones into your bags during lessons」，上課時需將手機放進包包，故選 B

STAY INSIDE THEIR HOMES.example:
【短文理解】[Weather Warning Note] Weather Warning: A strong typhoon is coming tomorrow. All schools and office buildings in the city will be closed. Please stay inside your home safely.
Q: What should people in the city do tomorrow?
STAY INSIDE THEIR HOMES.exampleZh: 警報文末提醒「Please stay inside your home safely.」（請安全待在家中），故選 C

REFUND OR EXCHANGE THEM.example:
【短文理解】[Clothing Store Sign] Season Clearance Sale: All summer shirts and shorts are 30% off! Sale ends this Sunday. No refunds or exchanges for sale items.
Q: What can a customer NOT do with the items bought on sale?
REFUND OR EXCHANGE THEM.exampleZh: 告示最後一句特別說明「No refunds or exchanges for sale items」（特價品不退不換），因此不能退換貨，選 D

FRESH MILK.example:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Taitung] Dear Andy, Taitung is very quiet and beautiful. We stayed at a small farm yesterday and drank fresh milk. Tomorrow morning we plan to ride bicycles along the forest path. Best regards, Grace.
Q: What did Grace drink at the farm yesterday?
FRESH MILK.exampleZh: 明信片寫道「We stayed at a small farm yesterday and drank fresh milk.」，因此昨天喝的是鮮奶，選 A

ON WEDNESDAY.example:
【短文理解】[Supermarket Member Notice] VIP Member Day is every Wednesday. Members get 10 bonus points for every $100 spent. Points can be used as cash on your next visit.
Q: On which day can members earn bonus points?
ON WEDNESDAY.exampleZh: 通知首句指明「VIP Member Day is every Wednesday.」（會員日為每週三），故選 B

AROUND THE CORNER.example: The entrance is around the corner.

examples.en: The entrance is around the corner.

DO YOU HAVE A BLUE ONE.word: do you have a blue one
DO YOU HAVE A BLUE ONE.example: Do you have a blue one.

WRITES.example: She writes an email to her boss every day.
WRITES.exampleZh: 主詞 She 是第三人稱單數，現在簡單式動詞字尾需要加 -s，因此選 writes。

THERE.example: there are two birds in the park.
THERE.exampleZh: There are 表示「有」，後面接複數名詞 two birds，所以選 There。

OUR.example: our flight is late, so we wait at the airport.
OUR.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「我們的」的實際運用。

WHERE.example: A: where is the bank? B: It is next to the park.
WHERE.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「在哪裡」的實際運用。

DOESNT.exampleZh: Mr. Lin ___ work here. 主詞是第三人稱單數，一般動詞的否定需用 doesn't

DRIVE.example: Can you drive me to the station?
DRIVE.exampleZh: 你可以開車送我到車站嗎？

BUT.example: She has a pen, but she does not have any paper.
BUT.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「但是；然而」的實際運用。

AN.exampleZh: umbrella 開頭是母音音，用 an。

HIM.example: A: Where is Mr. Lin? B: I do not see him.
HIM.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「他（受格）」的實際運用。

UNDER.example: The cat is sleeping under the sofa.
UNDER.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「在...下方」的實際運用。

ON THE DESK.example: We should focus on the usage of on the desk in modern English.
ON THE DESK.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「請把紙放在辦公桌上」的核心用法。

AT THE BANK.example: We should focus on the usage of at the bank in modern English.
AT THE BANK.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「我現在在銀行」的核心用法。

MILK AND MEAT.example: We should focus on the usage of milk and meat in modern English.
MILK AND MEAT.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「牛奶和肉」的核心用法。

NO IT IS NOT.example:
【短文理解】[Store Sign] Open Monday to Friday. Closed on Saturday and Sunday.
Q: Is the store open on Sunday?
NO IT IS NOT.exampleZh: 告示寫「Closed on Saturday and Sunday.（週六與週日休息）」，因此週日沒有營業，選 B

A NEW SOFA.example: We should focus on the usage of a new sofa in modern English.
A NEW SOFA.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「沙發」的核心用法。

A BLUE PEN.example: We should focus on the usage of a blue pen in modern English.
A BLUE PEN.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「我找不到我的藍筆」的核心用法。

AM.exampleZh: 主詞 I 搭配 be 動詞 am。

HE.example: This is my brother. he is a student.
HE.exampleZh: my brother（我的哥哥／弟弟）是男生、單數，代名詞用 He。

SHE.example: My mother is a nurse. she works at a hospital.
SHE.exampleZh: my mother 是女生、單數，代名詞用 She。

WE.example: Tom and I are in the same class. we are good friends.
WE.exampleZh: Tom and I（湯姆和我）包含「我」，代名詞用 We。

IT.example: Look at the cat! it is very cute.
IT.exampleZh: 動物（不知道性別時）用 It 代替。

THEY.example: Anna and Ben work here. they are very busy today.
THEY.exampleZh: Anna and Ben 是兩個人、不包含說話的人，代名詞用 They。

SPEAK.example: They speak English at work every day.
SPEAK.exampleZh: 主詞 They 是複數，一般現在式用原形 speak。

STUDIES.example: His wife studies English at a language school in Taipei.
STUDIES.exampleZh: 本題測試第三人稱單數動詞的變化。

WAKE.example: We wake up at six o'clock every day.

WHEN.example: when is your birthday? — It's in May.

WASH THE RICE.meaning: 請在我回來前幫忙洗米
WASH THE RICE.example: We should focus on the usage of wash the rice in modern English.
WASH THE RICE.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「請在我回來前幫忙洗米」的核心用法。

IN THE GARDEN.meaning: 我們正在花園裡吃大餐
IN THE GARDEN.example: We should focus on the usage of in the garden in modern English.
IN THE GARDEN.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「我們正在花園裡吃大餐」的核心用法。

TOMATOES.example: I want to buy three red tomatoes from the market.

CAKE.example: We have cake on her birthday.

YOUR.example: That is not your ruler. Mine is blue.
YOUR.exampleZh: 本題測試所有格形容詞。

RAISE A HAND TO SPEAK.example:

Q: What can a student do?

COOL.example: A: Is it warm outside right now? B: No, it is very cool. You need a jacket.

WINDY AND COOL.meaning: 明天台北將會起風且涼爽
WINDY AND COOL.example: We should focus on the usage of windy and cool in modern English.
WINDY AND COOL.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「明天台北將會起風且涼爽」的核心用法。

ITS.example: Look at the cute pig! its tail is short and curly.

SHOES.example: She wears a pink dress and two white shoes.

LIVE.example: I live in a small apartment.
LIVE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：此題測試現在簡單式。

RUNS.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：此題測試現在簡單式第三人稱單數。

EATS.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：此題測試現在簡單式的動詞變化。

MILK.example: Do you want milk in your coffee?

DO.exampleZh: you 的一般動詞疑問句用 Do 開頭。

SEE.meaning: 此題測試助動詞的用法
SEE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：此題測試助動詞的用法。

DRIVE A CAR.example: We should focus on the usage of drive a car in modern English.
DRIVE A CAR.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「此題測試短文理解」的核心用法。

READ.example: He reads the news every morning.

GOES.example: She goes to the movies on the weekend.
GOES.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：此題測試第三人稱單數動詞。

PLAYS.example: A: What does he do on the weekend? B: He plays games.
PLAYS.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：此題測試現在簡單式。

A BALL.meaning: 此題測試短文細節理解
A BALL.example: We should focus on the usage of a ball in modern English.
A BALL.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「此題測試短文細節理解」的核心用法。

STILL WATER PLEASE.example: The word is still water, please..
STILL WATER PLEASE.exampleZh: 服務生詢問要「常溫水還是氣泡水？」（Still or sparkling water），最適當的回答是「請給我們常溫水」（Still water, please）

PLATE.example: Please pass me that clean plate.

STREET.example: The bank is on Main Street.

VACATION.example: We went to Japan on vacation.

MUSEUM.example: The museum is free on Sundays.

SURE I WILL EMAIL IT NOW.word: sure, i will email it now.
SURE I WILL EMAIL IT NOW.meaning: 沒問題，我現在寄電子郵件給你
SURE I WILL EMAIL IT NOW.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
SURE I WILL EMAIL IT NOW.exampleZh: 對方提出請求「Could you please send me the file? (能否請你寄檔案給我？)」，適當回答為「Sure, I will email it now. (沒問題，我現在寄電子郵件給你)」

BLACK WITH NO SUGAR PLEASE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
BLACK WITH NO SUGAR PLEASE.exampleZh: 服務生或同事詢問咖啡喜好「How would you like your coffee? (你的咖啡想要怎麼調配？)」，回答「Black with no sugar, please. (請給我黑咖啡，不要糖)」最正確

MR CHEN IS LEADING IT.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
MR CHEN IS LEADING IT.exampleZh: 題目詢問負責人「Who is responsible for this project? (誰負責這個專案？)」，回答人選「Mr. Chen is leading it. (陳先生正在主導它)」最切合句意

WATER WOULD BE GREAT THANK YOU.word: water would be great, thank you.
WATER WOULD BE GREAT THANK YOU.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
WATER WOULD BE GREAT THANK YOU.exampleZh: 對方提供飲品選擇「Would you like some tea or water? (你想要喝茶還是水？)」，回答「Water would be great, thank you. (開水就好，謝謝你)」最自然合適

YES NEXT TO THE HOTEL.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES NEXT TO THE HOTEL.exampleZh: 詢問附近有無銀行「Is there a bank near here? (這附近有銀行嗎？)」，回答地點「Yes, next to the hotel. (有的，在飯店旁邊)」最正確

SURE NO PROBLEM.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
SURE NO PROBLEM.exampleZh: 請求對方重述「Could you repeat that? (你可以再說一次嗎？)」，答覆「Sure, no problem. (當然，沒問題)」最禮貌合適

AT FIVE THIRTY.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
AT FIVE THIRTY.exampleZh: 詢問火車發車時間「What time does the train leave? (火車幾點開？)」，回答時間「At five thirty. (五點半)」最正確

ABOUT AN HOUR.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
ABOUT AN HOUR.exampleZh: 詢問時間長度「How long is the meeting? (會議有多長？)」，回答時間長度「About an hour. (大約一小時)」最正確

THE BLACK ONE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
THE BLACK ONE.exampleZh: 詢問哪一個是特定物品「Which one is your bag? (哪一個是你的包包？)」，回答物品特徵「The black one. (黑色的那一個)」最正確

NO EVERYTHING IS CLEAR.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
NO EVERYTHING IS CLEAR.exampleZh: 會議或解說後詢問「Do you have any questions? (你有任何問題嗎？)」，回答「No, everything is clear. (沒有，一切都很清楚)」最合適

I NEED YOUR HELP WITH A FILE.word: i need your help with a file.
I NEED YOUR HELP WITH A FILE.meaning: 我需要你幫忙處理一個檔案
I NEED YOUR HELP WITH A FILE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
I NEED YOUR HELP WITH A FILE.exampleZh: 對方詢問「Why did you call me? (你為什麼打給我？)」，回答原因「I need your help with a file. (我需要你幫忙處理一個檔案)」最正確

IT WAS GREAT I WENT TO TAIPEI.word: it was great, i went to taipei.
IT WAS GREAT I WENT TO TAIPEI.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
IT WAS GREAT I WENT TO TAIPEI.exampleZh: 對方詢問「How was your weekend? (你週末過得如何？)」，回答「It was great, I went to Taipei. (很棒，我去了台北)」最合適

IT BELONGS TO MR LIN.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
IT BELONGS TO MR LIN.exampleZh: 對方詢問物品擁有者「Whose bag is this? (這是誰的包包？)」，回答「It belongs to Mr. Lin. (這是林先生的)」最合適

ID LOVE TO THANK YOU.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
ID LOVE TO THANK YOU.exampleZh: 對方提出邀請「Would you like to join us for dinner? (你想和我們一起吃晚餐嗎？)」，欣然接受「I'd love to, thank you. (我很樂意，謝謝)」最禮貌合適

RIGHT THIS WAY PLEASE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
RIGHT THIS WAY PLEASE.exampleZh: 在餐廳門口詢問「Can we have a table for two? (我們能有兩個人的位子嗎？)」，服務生回答「Right this way, please. (請走這邊)」最標準

YES IT IS VERY CHEAP.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES IT IS VERY CHEAP.exampleZh: 詢問購買意願「Do you want to buy it? (你想買它嗎？)」，回答意願與理由「Yes, it is very cheap. (想，它很便宜)」最合理

I LIKE THE RED ONE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
I LIKE THE RED ONE.exampleZh: 詢問顏色偏好「Which color do you like? (你喜歡哪一個顏色？)」，回答「I like the red one. (我喜歡紅色的那一個)」最正確

CAN I PAY BY CARD.meaning: 我可以用信用卡付款嗎？
CAN I PAY BY CARD.exampleZh: 我可以用信用卡付款嗎？

GO TO THE SERVICE DESK.meaning: 在服務台領取免費飲料兌換券
GO TO THE SERVICE DESK.example:
【短文理解】[Flight Ticket Message] Flight BR28 to San Francisco is delayed. The new departure time is 11:45 p.m. Passengers can wait at Gate 12 and get a free drink voucher from the service desk.

GO TO THE SERVICE DESK.exampleZh: 文末指出旅客可以「get a free drink voucher from the service desk」（在服務台領取免費飲料兌換券），故選 B

THERE IS NO TRASH COLLECTION ON SUNDAY.word: there is no trash collection on sunday.
THERE IS NO TRASH COLLECTION ON SUNDAY.example:
【短文理解】[Apartment Rules] Welcome to your new home. Please do not play loud music after 10:00 p.m. Put your trash bags in the collection area on the first floor before 8:00 a.m. every morning except Sunday.

THERE IS NO TRASH COLLECTION ON SUNDAY.exampleZh: 文中「every morning except Sunday」表示星期日沒有垃圾清運，故選 B

MARY.meaning: 瑪麗今天將代替他主持
MARY.example:
【短文理解】[Business Email] Dear Team, John is sick today and cannot lead the marketing meeting at 3 p.m. Mary will take his place today. Please send your weekly reports to Mary before 2 p.m.
Q: Who will lead the marketing meeting today?
MARY.exampleZh: 文中明確提到「Mary will take his place today」（瑪麗今天將代替他主持），因此今天由 Mary 主持會議

A PERSON WHO WANTS TO WORK ON WEEKENDS.word: a person who wants to work on weekends.
A PERSON WHO WANTS TO WORK ON WEEKENDS.example:

Q: Who can apply for this job?
